project.title: Private broker connection owner
project.goal: Own actual SQLite connections and retain namespace protection until every connection is confirmed closed
project.scope: Physical owning runtime and fixed typed dispatch; canonical bootstrap/adoption/transports and full platform qualification remain required

boundary.responsibility: Layout before SQLite open, fixed application dispatch, sticky retirement and confirmed-close/BUSY quarantine
boundary.rationale: Do not release protection while any real SQLite handle survives
excludes: Bootstrap, schema adoption, legacy drain qualification, endpoints, deployment, macOS namespace profile

scenario.normal.description: Original files preserve committed rows and lease is released after confirmed close

scenario.given: Offline-provisioned strict Linux profile and synthetic persistent files
scenario.when: Open actual owner, commit, close both handles and reopen in another process
scenario.then: Original files preserve committed rows and lease is released after confirmed close

scenario.busy.description: Retain exact busy connection and entire guard until process exit

scenario.given: Either real SQLite connection has an outstanding prepared statement and active transaction
scenario.when: Close, retry and drop the owner or close failure
scenario.then: Retain exact busy connection and entire guard until process exit

scenario.partial.description: Clean connection closes or busy connection and complete guard are quarantined

scenario.given: Control connection opened while company is not yet opened
scenario.when: Return an error or unwind a test-only fault in actual constructor
scenario.then: Clean connection closes or busy connection and complete guard are quarantined

scenario.retired.description: Retirement remains sticky and SQLite locks are preserved

scenario.given: Owner admitted or physical namespace changed
scenario.when: Dispatch unwinds or namespace is invalidated and restored
scenario.then: Retirement remains sticky and SQLite locks are preserved

scenario.privacy.description: Compilation fails; fixed typed methods expose only known application outcomes

scenario.given: External consumer of the public host crate
scenario.when: Attempt mutable callback, connection field or conversion extraction
scenario.then: Compilation fails; fixed typed methods expose only known application outcomes

scenario.concurrent.description: Lease and SQLite locks remain, client file access is refused; process exit releases quarantine

scenario.given: First owner holds lease and WAL or DELETE transactions
scenario.when: Independent same-broker contenders and different-UID clients compete
scenario.then: Lease and SQLite locks remain, client file access is refused; process exit releases quarantine

scenario.outcome.description: Preserve exact application outcome and separately signal retirement without manufacturing a retry

scenario.given: Application has committed or reports ambiguous/rejected outcome
scenario.when: Observe connection reuse flags and physical namespace after dispatch
scenario.then: Preserve exact application outcome and separately signal retirement without manufacturing a retry

action.host_owner.description: Own protected connections, dispatch fixed commands and close safely

output.description: Opaque Owner or exact typed application outcome with retirement; close failure owns only retired private state

errors.refused: Namespace/profile/DB/retired refusal, typed original application failures, or close pending

preconditions: Offline provision, current strict namespace and enrolled trusted broker UID
Native schema and prior-writer drain/bootstrap authority established separately by trusted host
No independent regular descriptor operations on live protected SQLite inodes
postconditions: Every SQLite handle closes successfully before layout release, or whole unresolved set survives until process exit
Retirement is sticky on panic/validation/reuse failure; exact application outcome retained
external_effects: Acquire directory flock and actual SQLite handles; ordinary journal recovery may write existing files
Fixed commands may commit application business/audit/idempotency changes
Pending-close quarantine retains OS descriptors, locks and memory until process exit

boundaries.rationale: Private non-escaping API, partial construction and unsupported profile

concurrency.rationale: Real DB locks and entire workspace lease retained through close BUSY

authorization.rationale: Physical ownership does not replace frozen application authorization or trusted provisioning

idempotency.rationale: Exact application outcome/receipt survives postdispatch retirement; never invent automatic retry

atomicity.rationale: Never release pinned resources while either SQLite close remains unconfirmed

action.host_owner.behavior: Acquire namespace before first open; retain partial state; retire before dispatch; preserve original typed result and separately report retirement; explicitly close every handle or quarantine entire unresolved state
